bullets: Top contributor to both the frontend and backend repos in an 8-person Scrum team, working in sprints from a shared backlog.
Built login by username or email and dual-role accounts, so one user can act as both customer and provider.
Built the provider dashboard, the create-service flow with cover photo upload, and a search filter panel whose filters sync to the URL.
Wrote the create-service REST API with Jest tests, and Playwright end-to-end tests for the login flow against a mocked API generated from the OpenAPI spec.

projects.title: Binance TH Portfolio Tracker
bullets: Directed Claude Code to build a local dashboard for my Binance TH account: holdings in THB, realized and unrealized P/L, and money- and time-weighted returns compared with holding BTC.
Wrote the requirements, tested each feature on my real account, and added Discord alerts, CSV export and automatic backups.

projects.title: Crypto Trading Bot
bullets: Designed a staged rollout (backtest → paper trading → small capped live account) for four pairs on Binance TH; currently paper trading on a dedicated always-on PC.
Compared MA-crossover, RSI and Donchian strategies in backtests with fees, slippage and a walk-forward overfitting check, and chose MA 10/200 on 4-hour candles.

images.caption: Backtest of MA 10/200 vs buy & hold on BTCUSDT 4h candles, out of sample with fees and slippage. 1 Jan 2024 – 4 Oct 2026: return +97% vs +101%, worst drop −32% vs −53%.
images.alt: Line chart of return since start for the MA 10/200 strategy and for buy and hold on BTCUSDT, January 2024 to October 2026. Buy and hold climbs higher and falls further; the strategy stays flatter and ends just below it.

courseProjects.title: Real-time video capture on an FPGA
courseProjects.course: Hardware Synthesis Lab · team of two
courseProjects.description: In Verilog on a Basys 3 (Artix-7), configured an OV7670 camera through a hand-written SCCB (I²C-like) bus master, buffered frames in dual-port BRAM bridging the camera and VGA clock domains, and output 640×480 @ 60 Hz video with switchable greyscale, invert and threshold filters.

images.caption: Top-level block diagram from the project report: three clock domains joined by a dual-port BRAM frame buffer.
images.alt: Block diagram in three clock domains. 100 MHz: cam_ctrl configures the OV7670 camera over SCCB, and an MMCM makes the 25 MHz clock. Camera clock: pixel_capture turns the RGB565 stream into RGB444 and writes the frame_buffer. 25 MHz: vga_sync reads the frame buffer, img_filter applies the selected filter, and the result goes to the VGA monitor.
